title: Seafood Boil with Garlic Butter Toss
description: Gulf Coast style boil with crab, shrimp, seared scallops, turkey jalapeno sausage, corn and potatoes, finished in garlic butter.

ingredients.name: baby gold or red potatoes
ingredients.note: halved if larger than golf-ball size

ingredients.name: ears fresh corn on the cob
large yellow onion
ingredients.note: cut into big wedges so it is easy to pick out

steps.title: Prep the scallops
steps.text: Place {scallops} on a paper-towel-lined plate, pat very dry, and refrigerate until the sear. Dry scallops are what give you a golden crust.

steps.title: Prep the vegetables
steps.text: Halve {potatoes} if larger than golf-ball size, cut {corn} into thirds, halve {mushrooms} if large, and cut {onion} into big wedges.

steps.title: Prep the rest
steps.text: Cut {sausage} into 2 to 3 inch pieces, peel {freshgarlic}, and halve {lemons}.

steps.title: Build the boil
steps.text: Fill the stockpot about three-quarters full with water and set the pasta insert in. Add {oldbay}, {salt}, {bayleaves}, {freshgarlic}, {onion}, and {lemons}.

steps.title: Infuse the water
steps.text: Bring the pot to a rolling boil, then reduce to a strong simmer for 10 minutes. This seasons the potatoes and corn from the inside, not just the final toss.

steps.title: Potatoes
steps.text: Add {potatoes} and cook 15 to 18 minutes, until just barely fork-tender. They keep cooking a bit from residual heat.

steps.title: Corn and mushrooms
steps.text: Add {corn} and {mushrooms} and cook 5 to 7 minutes.

steps.title: Sausage
steps.text: Add {sausage} and cook 5 minutes. It is precooked, so this just heats it through and lets it pick up the broth.

steps.title: Crab
steps.text: Add {crab} and cook 5 to 6 minutes. It is already cooked, so you are only reheating and flavoring it.

steps.title: Shrimp
steps.text: Add {shrimp} and cook 2 to 3 minutes, until pink and just cooked through. Stay close, shrimp turn rubbery fast.

steps.title: Sear the scallops
steps.text: While the shrimp cook, heat a cast iron skillet over medium-high heat with {scallopbutter}. Sear {scallops} 60 to 90 seconds per side until golden, without crowding the pan. Scallops are seared separately because they turn rubbery in a rolling boil.

steps.title: Lift and drain
steps.text: Lift the pasta insert out of the pot and let everything drain briefly. Pick out the {bayleaves} and {lemons}. Keep the {onion} wedges and {freshgarlic} cloves in with the food so you can eat or skip them.

steps.title: Make the garlic butter
steps.text: Melt {butter} in a small saucepan over low heat. Stir in {jarredgarlic}, {cajun}, and {hotsauce} if using, and simmer 2 to 3 minutes to bloom the garlic and spices. Do not let it brown.

steps.title: Toss
steps.text: In a very large bowl, combine the drained boil with the seared scallops and pour the garlic butter over everything. Toss to coat thoroughly. This step is what makes it a restaurant-style boil.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve right away, family style, with extra lemon wedges and hot sauce on the side.

notes: Scaled as two dinners for two. Night two: before cooking, hold back some raw shrimp and scallops in the fridge. Reheat the crab, sausage, potatoes and corn, and top up with a fresh potato and ear of corn if needed. In a skillet, sear the scallops in butter first, add the shrimp about a minute later, and cook 2 to 3 minutes until the shrimp are pink. Finish with leftover or freshly made garlic butter. For more heat in the pot, add a light pinch of cayenne to the boil water.
